behavioralVerification: Pure CPU allocation on one-, two-, six-, and 64-CPU hosts; job caps, override precedence, and invalid values.
Nix/Guix argument syntax and parity with the standalone Go helper.
Separate synchronous/asynchronous cache writers exclude each other and reuse one accepted installation without FIFO assumptions.
Installation and lock release failures preserve both causes and changed ownership.
Malformed worker requests fail before filesystem/subprocess effects.
Signals during preparation stop admission; admitted preparations, commands, and cleanup drain; listeners restore.
Bounded admission creates and releases workspaces before admitting the next job; reports survive.
Uncertain cleanup preserves affected workspaces and coordinator claims.
Failed log sinks drain verbose child output and retain the failure.
Shared cache ownership skips disappeared children, rejects missing roots/permission errors, and does not traverse symlink entries.

initialFailure.reason: Checks passed, then recursive shared-store ownership restoration encountered SQLite entries removed by another pnpm job.
initialFailure.fix: Restore shared cache ownership inside the managed shell, tolerating only ENOENT for child entries; preserve root/permission/I/O failures.
